reason: I already take Toplux and reorder when it runs out. $29.99 is more than I pay now and I have a drawer of half-used bottles already, so I'm not adding another one.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. On $32k I can't justify paying more for a magnesium I haven't tried.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 to $18 for the box, or a free sample sachet so I can see it actually works better than what I take now.
